name: Match Shape
scope: ATP best-of-three singles, all surfaces, main draw and qualifying; no Challenger/WTA/BO5/team/exhibition
primary_comparison: Current pricing (existing totals shift and handicap calibration) versus frozen T1 without stacking the old corrections
diagnostic_comparison: Raw current score kernel and winner-mass-only C0 control; distinct from issued Strict signals
selection: First fresh post-registration forecast and paired market per fixture/market. Main line, else closest margin-adjusted probability to 50%. Same contract and odds for every arm. Choose the higher EV side; EV >= 10% and conditional probability edge >= 5 percentage points. One selection per arm/fixture/market.
settlement: Exact native edition/round/player IDs, completed legal BO3 score. Integer pushes return stake. Retirements/walkovers/defaults/abandonments remain excluded for grading review, not counted as losses or wins. No bookmaker-account execution/settlement claim.
roi_denominator: One unit per settled selection including pushes; pending and excluded have no settled stake
calibration: Every settled captured contract, not only selections; non-push conditional binary probabilities; Brier/log loss and observed/expected. Fixture counts separate from correlated market counts.
